contracts.protected_resource: The per-thread workspace directory tree SessionDB/<thread_id>/workspace (Tools/utils.py 17-31).

scope_limits: The gate confines the resolved target path only; it does not restrict content, write volume, or which in-workspace files may be modified.
target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) at Tools/edit.py 186 runs only after _resolve accepts, so directory creation is likewise confined to the accepted target's ancestry.

Only the Edit tool's write path is covered; shell-based writes through the terminal tool and the automatic requirements.txt bookkeeping write (_record_requirements, Tools/terminal.py 170-200) are separate mechanisms outside this contract.
The tool-call budget check (Tools/edit.py 175-181) is a separate rate limit, not part of this obligation.

contracts.protection_obligation: Shell commands submitted through the SafeShell 'terminal' tool must be denied unless every base command parsed from the command string is in the configured shell_permissions whitelist and, while the shell_restriction flag is enabled, the Tools.terminal_agent.checker_agent LLM reviewer allows the command; both denials must be produced inside _execute/_execute_async before the command reaches _run_subprocess.
